headline: Jefferson win at last after six straight defeats
dek: Jefferson's win over Bryant and Stratton is their first of the season and follows six defeats, more than any other programme has suffered. They have scored ten goals and conceded seventeen.

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Georgian Court's nineteen goals are more than Dominican, Holy Family and Post have scored between them, yet they have conceded fifteen: the conference's scoring is concentrated in one side, and its defending is not.

wire.line: Post have won more than they have lost and have conceded seven goals all season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Post have scored eight and conceded seven; the win at Dominican makes it three wins, two draws and two defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Georgian Court's four wins remain the most in the conference, but the defeat at Millersville is their second and lifts their goals conceded to fifteen.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Dominican have scored three goals all season and conceded thirteen; the defeat to Post was their fifth, beside one win and one draw.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Gijs van Eif has five goals and five assists for Georgian Court from 35 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Max Bond has made 43 saves for Chestnut Hill and conceded twelve, a save percentage of .782.

last_match.line: Georgian Court's heaviest defeat of the season, and the first match in which they have failed to score.

next_match.line: Caldwell have not drawn a match all season; Holy Family are the last side yet to play a conference match.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
